facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; you may keep all foreign currency you receive, with no forced conversion.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: banks hold foreign-currency deposits; each bank sets cash withdrawal limits.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Paymob is licensed and may accept individuals with a national ID; ask them first.
facts.L1_registration: Register for tax within 30 days of starting, at the tax office or online.
facts.L2_tax_id: A tax registration number on a tax card from the Egyptian Tax Authority.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Foreign-client income is taxed; under EGP 20m, a simplified 0.4–1.5% turnover tax.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 14% VAT; exporters must register for VAT whatever their turnover.
facts.L5_data_protection: Data law 151/2020: licences required from November 2026, when the grace period ends.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Buyers can return goods within 14 days; show your tax card details online.
facts.L7_incentives: Simplified turnover tax (0.4–1.5%) and zero VAT on exported services.

watch_out.text: Consultants earning 90% from one or two clients can't use the simplified regime.
Exporters must register for VAT even below EGP 500,000 a year.
Platforms paying through PayPal Payouts can't pay Egyptian accounts.
